unmapped.segment: Subject: Northwind pitch brief - "Moving People" (rough notes, sorry!)
Hi team — throwing this over before the weekend, it's a bit of a brain dump from the call + the deck Marketing sent.
Pull it together however you like.
So the headline: Northwind Motors passenger cars, UK + Ireland.
We want a brand campaign for the NX range (the EVs) for 2027.
We are NOT cheap and we don't want to pretend to be.

What we actually need from this pitch: a platform idea that resets how the UK feels about Northwind electric — something that can run 3+ years, work across TV/social/retail/dealer, and travel into Ireland without feeling like a London ad.
Big emotional brand thing, not a product readout.
Sustainability has to be credible, they are paranoid about greenwashing accusations after the diesel thing.
Oh and they keep saying the word "joy" — I think that's the unlock honestly.
We also need to show we understand their dealer network — dealers feel left out of brand campaigns.
